doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: George Washington and George Orendorff
summary: A muddle about which George played trombone on a picture; Orendorff is a trumpeter still living.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: George. What George? George. George Washington. George Washington, he's not from New Orleans.
Yeah, but he's on that picture with the Pity Band and Chester.
This George Washington here would play trombone?
Maybe this is a different one. It has to be a different one. Oh, George, I've never seen George in my life.
No? He my little boy. Then George ain't as old as us. Not this George I'm talking about. Oh, no, George must be a man about 55 years old. He couldn't be. He ain't that old.
That's a different one. Oh, no. Jim Robinson is from him.
Jim Robinson's older than me. Yeah. Oh, yeah. I don't know what he's saying, but I know he is. George Orendorf is up the line.
Oh, George Orendorf is still here?
